node: Supply-chain visibility, compliance, traceability, and contractor risk software
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around supply-chain visibility and compliance software for defense/government supply chains. The strongest policy signal is that DoD and primes lack visibility below tier 2 while average DoD supply chains span 5-6 tiers, creating a plausible recurring demand pool for supplier illumination, CMMC/cyber compliance, sanctions/export screening, and operational risk platforms. The discovery lane remains thin because many pure-play leaders are private, while public exposures are split across high-attention AI platforms, niche cyber/GRC vendors, trade-compliance software, and mission-specific analytics vendors. No investment recommendation is made.
